 Our client is a leading organisation operating within a secure and technically complex environment and is seeking to engage a DevSecOps Engineer on a permanent basis. Working as part of a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure that support critical business outcomes.   This role is based in Brisbane and requires a commitment to working onsite 4-5 days per week. Due to the nature of the environment, this position cannot be performed remotely. Brisbane-based candidates are strongly preferred, however applications are welcomed from interstate candidates who are genuinely committed to relocating. Joining a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure supporting critical business outcomes.  An NV2 Security Clearance is highly desirable. We also encourage applications from candidates who hold NV1 or Baseline clearances, or Australian Citizens who are eligible and willing to obtain a security clearance. 
   Your new role     
 As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, implementation and ongoing support of secure software development environments and CI/CD pipelines. Working alongside engineering, infrastructure and security teams, you will help drive automation, improve platform performance and ensure development environments remain secure, scalable and compliant.   
  Key responsibilities:   
 
 Designing, implementing and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines 
 Supporting and optimising secure software development environments 
 Deploying, configuring and maintaining Kubernetes and Docker platforms 
 Developing and supporting GitLab CI/CD workflows and integrations

  What you'll need to succeed

  Key requirements:  
 
 CI/CD pipeline design, implementation and support

 Kubernetes and Docker environments

  Highly desirable:

  What you'll get in return

result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Road Roller Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Road Roller Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of road rollers to compact soil, gravel, asphalt and other construction materials for roads, hardstands, building platforms and civil infrastructure works. The role is responsible for achieving specified compaction standards while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate road rollers safely and efficiently to compact soil, gravel, crushed rock, asphalt and other construction materials. 
-  Achieve specified compaction standards for roads, hardstands, building pads, foundations and civil infrastructure. 
-  Compact fill layers in accordance with project specifications and engineering requirements. 
-  Perform rolling operations for pavement construction, roadworks, drainage and site preparation activities. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, compaction specifications and supervisor instructions. 
-  Monitor rolling patterns and identify areas requiring additional compaction. 
-  Coordinate safely with graders, excavators, loaders and other mobile plant during earthworks operations. 
-  Conduct daily pre-start inspections and complete required plant inspection documentation. 
-  Monitor equipment performance and report faults or maintenance requirements promptly. 
-  Carry out routine servicing, lubrication and minor maintenance within competency limits. 
-  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox meetings and safety interactions. 
-  Operate safely around personnel, mobile plant, underground services and fixed infrastructure. 
-  Maintain compliance with Grounded, client and statutory safety requirements. 
-  Complete required plant logs, inspection records and production documentation accurately. 
-  Assist with site establishment and other construction activities where required. 
-  Maintain housekeeping standards around work areas and equipment. 
-  Contribute to achieving project production, quality and safety objectives. 

Skills and Abilities:
-  Relevant qualification equivalent to AQF Certificate II or Certificate III, or equivalent industry experience. 
-  Minimum one (1) year relevant experience operating road rollers. 
-  Current Driver’s Licence (HR – MC Role Dependant) 
-  Operating SOA 
-  Operating VOC (2 years validity)


Salary range is $75,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 20th July 2026 and closes on 20th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

 Safely operate and maintain mobile plant and equipment, including Front-End Loaders, Telehandlers, and Water Trucks.

Electrician (General) positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufactures high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Electrician (General) based at our NSW Office. You will be responsible for electrical installation, wiring, fit out, and testing of prefabricated switchrooms, modular skids, and transportable units. The role ensures all work is delivered safely, efficiently, and to specification in alignment with project schedule. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

KEY RESULT AREAS
WHS:
Work safely using appropriate SWMS, Risk Assessments, or Safety Operating Procedures
Immediately report hazards to a supervisor or safety representative and monitor corrective actions
Take reasonable care for the health and safety of all people and the environment at work.

Key Responsibilities:
Install and terminate electrical systems in modular switchrooms, skids, and prefabricated enclosures
Interpret modular electrical schematics, drawings, and scopes of work
